_context: Owner LM-D (LAUNCH-MONITOR-SPEC 3.2-3.4), lazy namespace. estimated_badge: the word under every inferred (model) tile. viz.*: the hero chart above the tiles. sheet.*: the tile editor (buttons only, no dragging). detail.*: the sheet a tile opens. origin.<value_origin>: one sentence on how a number was obtained.
nav.label: Other shots from this session
club.change: Club: {name}. Tap to change the club and recalculate
club.title: Club used for this shot
club.hint: After a change, the estimated numbers are recalculated for the new club. The old numbers stay in the correction history.
club.changed_only: Club changed (this camera angle has no ball data, so nothing to recalculate)
rederive.none: This shot was saved by an older version, which did not work out spin, landing or the flight path.
rederive.stale: The estimated numbers of this shot come from an older model.
rederive.failed: Could not recalculate right now. Try again later.
sheet.title: Choose tiles
sheet.auto_hint: Shows the most useful numbers for {view}
sheet.max: You can pick up to {n}. Turn one off first.
kind.measured: Measured by tracking the video (after calibration and fitting).
kind.inferred: Estimated with a physics model, not measured directly.
kind.null: This shot has no value for this number.
origin.pose: Method: worked out from the tracked body joints.
origin.ball_fit3d: Method: a 3D fit to the ball's path in the air.
origin.ball_fit2d: Method: a fit to the ball's path in the picture.
origin.ballistics: Method: the ball's flight simulated from ball speed, launch angle and spin.
origin.dplane: Method: worked back with the D-plane model from launch direction, launch angle and club data.
origin.spin_model: Method: a collision model of spin loft and club speed, combined with typical values for this club.
origin.flight_model: Method: the whole flight simulated with an aerodynamic model.
origin.prior: Method: a typical value for this club.
viz.label: Ball flight
viz.no_flight.dtl: Shots filmed from behind have no ball flight data, so the swing tempo is shown here.
viz.no_flight.fps: The frame rate is too low to work out the ball flight, so the swing tempo is shown here.
viz.no_flight.none: This shot has no flight path yet. Use “Recalculate with the new model” below to add one.
viz.no_flight.other: This shot has no flight data, so the swing tempo is shown here.
viz.side_unknown: Face-on video cannot see left or right, so the landing spot sits on the centre line and its side is unknown.
viz.no_tracer: no ball path to draw for this shot
viz.video_missing: The video is not on this device, so only the ball path is drawn. Solid: the detected ball; dotted: simulated.
viz.failed: This chart cannot be shown right now.
legend: ● measured · ◐ estimated · ▲ low confidence · — not measurable
